criteria.name: scope and rollback integrity
criteria.acceptance: Only the three allowlisted product files differ from C1L snapshots; the conversation fixture and all historical C1J/C1K evidence remain unchanged.

criteria.name: fresh output binding and path safety
criteria.acceptance: Active npm and output bindings use C1L; C1J historical output remains accepted; unapproved C1L names, traversal, and symlink escapes remain rejected.

criteria.name: candidate identity
criteria.acceptance: A new C1L candidate verifies against the immutable 973-input C1J baseline, contains the four approved additions (977 total), and is unchanged after checks.

criteria.name: dependency inventory
criteria.acceptance: Inventory report is complete, matches the candidate fingerprint, has gaps=[], unresolved=0, and records the 11 known findings (9 DEPENDENCY_CATEGORY_MISMATCH and 2 MISSING_DIRECT_DEPENDENCY) with expected exit 1.

criteria.name: regression and coverage
criteria.acceptance: Focused scanner/dependency/conversation tests, full npm test, typecheck, lint, and coverage pass on the final source; thresholds remain statements >=90%, branches >=85%, functions >=90%, lines >=90%.

criteria.name: provenance and recovery
criteria.acceptance: Each command is captured individually with argv, UTC timing, duration, exit code, stdout/stderr paths, byte counts and hashes; command records verify with zero stream-integrity problems; rollback snapshots exist.

criteria.name: safety and boundaries
criteria.acceptance: npm runs offline with PostgreSQL variables unset; no real data, service, database, external network, sensitive action, or production change; G21-5/G21-6 remain closed and production NO_GO.

non_acceptance: C1L does not include the independent-review criteria C1J-08/C1J-09 and cannot accept M07-S1. Those criteria remain unavailable until a separate valid review and disposition exist.
